_comment: Field names for BXON tables, keyed by table JSON path under game_assets/tables/packs. Only fields with recorded evidence are named; everything else stays addressable by offset. Strings are read-only (edits must keep the file size).

name.evidence: item name shown in menus (matches translation DB)

buy_price.evidence: Medicinal herb = 8; sell_price == buy_price/2 for 629 of 865 priced items

field_model.evidence: row of gamecmn/res_model3d (w1003 for Flametang boomerang); all 946 weapon rows point at w* models

battle_model.evidence: row of gamecmn/res_model3d (w1603 for Flametang boomerang)

model_variant.evidence: 0 -> a, 1 -> b, 2 -> c model suffix (Flametang boomerang = 1 -> w1603b)

model.evidence: monster model code, e.g. m001a; names in model_names.json

name.evidence: place name (matches translation DB, e.g. Heliodor)
